fact: The Bank of Namibia's Determination on Localization of Core Banking Systems (BID 19), signed 5 August 2008 and effective 11 August 2008, requires all authorised banking institutions to locate and maintain their core banking systems, where accounting and other banking records are kept, in Namibia.

fact: NDP6 plans a National Data Centre to store government information and keep critical national data hosted within Namibia.
The Prime Minister's spokesperson says a national data centre to house government servers is at a preliminary stage and part of the national development plan NDP6, with no procurement yet.
CRAN's Elton Witbooi says the Office of the Prime Minister is leading plans to establish a dedicated government data centre.
